description: The public mockworld mock registry. `mockworld add mock:<name>` installs from here.

mocks.name: slack
mocks.description: Fake Slack. Post messages, list channels, read history, and add reactions with realistic channel membership, threading, and Slack-shaped {ok:false, error} bodies.

mocks.name: twilio
mocks.description: Fake Twilio SMS. Send messages and track delivery with realistic segment billing, balance, a queued→delivered status lifecycle, invalid-number and opt-out (STOP) handling, and Twilio-shaped error codes.

mocks.name: weather
mocks.description: Fake weather API — stations + deterministic forecast (authoring example).
